wiki.title: Tony Gonzales
wiki.extract: Ernest Anthony Gonzales II (born October 10, 1980) is an American politician and United States Navy veteran who served as the U.S. representative for Texas's 23rd congressional district from 2021 until his resignation in April 2026. He is a member of the Republican Party.
